signedInt32Corrections.reason: The client table binary encodes every non-float scalar as signed int32, but tools/decode_binary_table.py read_int decodes varints unsigned (read_uint), so negative int32 values in PGR_DATA/en/bytes JSON appear as 2**32+n. signedInt32Corrections.impactIfNotCorrected: TableGeneratorV2 int.TryParse overflows on 4294967196, so the column would silently generate as string.
signedInt32Corrections.scopeVerified: Grepped every PGR_DATA/en theatre4 JSON for integers >= 2**31: exactly these 6 occurrences; theatre5/theatre6 have none.
